headline: War in Iran: 12 billion in energy costs for Italian families and businesses
summary: Energy costs for Italian families and businesses have reached almost 12 billion euros over six months, according to the National Confederation of Craftsmanship and Small and Medium-sized Enterprises. The estimate is linked to the war in Iran.
why: Energy prices feed into inflation, household spending and industrial margins, particularly for energy-intensive small firms. Italy is a major European economy highly exposed to imported fuel.
